checks.name: Profile entry and validation
checks.evidence: Keyboard skip targets the form; short/empty handles focus the username with an associated error. One anchored original bee, no roaming layer.

checks.name: Profile photo controls
checks.evidence: All 12 local avatars loaded; select/remove works. Invalid type and >5MB are rejected. Upload failure recovers. Camera opens the capture file input; selected image updates preview through an isolated callback. Native mobile camera and real Cloudinary upload not claimed.

checks.name: Save response states
checks.evidence: Unavailable username and general failures retain entered details, clear loading and allow retry. Success callback receives normalized username, selected photo and bio. Fixture makes no account writes; service/gate contract verified separately in Vitest.

checks.name: Original bee reactions
checks.evidence: Actual original wave video advances on click; reduced motion replaces playback with the unchanged still artwork. No autonomous flight on onboarding.

checks.name: Profile responsive layouts
checks.evidence: No horizontal overflow at 320, 390, 768, 1024 and 1440px; all three palettes captured at desktop and mobile sizes.

checks.name: Three-way public themes
checks.evidence: Landing, login, signup and profile completion cycle warm light → forest → black/yellow → warm light. All three audited at 1440/390px. Choice survives route navigation and reload. App's hivez-theme remains dark.

checks.name: Auth navigation retains theme
checks.evidence: Client-side login → signup switch keeps black/yellow selected.
